text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa! Thanks for the birthday wishes! You 
actually remembered my birthday? That 
brings me nothing but pure joy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, and besides congratulations, I also 
wanted to express my gratitude today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with Helios, it makes me feel 
like I can just shrug off and run away 
from petty worries.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's stay besties and front-running 
buddies forever, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Saying that totally gets me hyped! Right 
back atcha—besties and front-running 
buddies forever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna run away from 
Palmer's burning passion until the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...No, don't run away from their 
feelings—accept them.
